run_wecom_bot: run the WeCom bot application that streams LLM responses to allowed users via WebSocket
handle_incoming_text_message: handle incoming WeCom text messages by queuing prompts to the GeneraticAgent and streaming responses
send_streamed_text_reply: send streamed text replies to a WeCom chat with content splitting for long messages
send_welcome_message: send a welcome message to a user when they enter a WeCom chat
configure_wecom_bot_access: configure WeCom bot with allowed users, bot ID, secret, and welcome message from llmcore keys
